verses.1: And Joseph came out of Egypt. Potiphar, the captain of the police, a man from Egypt, took him in. He was brought there by the Ishmaelites.
verses.2: And Jehovah made Joseph a successful man. He became a leader in his own house, which was in Egypt.
verses.3: And Adonai saw that Hezekiah and everything He did were successful in His hands.
verses.4: And Joseph found favor in his eyes. He took him into his household, and he gave him all his possessions.
verses.5: From that time on, he was placed in his house, along with everything he owned. Jehovah blessed the Egyptian house because of Joseph. Thus, Jehovah’s blessing came to all that he had in the house and in the field.
verses.6: And he left behind everything he owned in the hands of Joseph. He didn’t know what to do with it; all he knew was that it was food that he could eat. Joseph was a good man, and he was also very handsome.
verses.7: And after these things, Adonai’s wife opened her eyes and looked at Joseph. She said, “I am with you.”
verses.8: And he said to his wife, “These are my treasures. I do not know what there is in these rooms, and everything that belongs to them has been given into my hands.”
verses.9: He is not greater than me in this house. He does not deserve any respect from me, because I am your husband. How can I commit such a great sin? What wickedness have I done against God?
verses.10: And as she spoke to Joseph, days passed by, but he did not listen to her. He did not go to bed with her to be with her.
verses.11: And it came to this day, and the woman went into the house to do her work. But there was no one among the people in the house that day.
verses.12: And he was deceived, thinking that she had slept with him. But she took his clothes from him and ran away.
verses.13: And it seemed as though she had left something in her hand. Then, the horn was blown.
verses.14: And she called out to the people of her house, and said to them, “Look! Bring us a Hebrew man who can make us laugh. Let him come and lie down with me, and I will laugh loudly.”
verses.15: And when they heard that I had raised my voice and called out, they left me behind. They rushed away from me.
verses.16: And he laid her down beside her, until her husband came home.
verses.17: And he spoke to him with these words: “Do not be angry with me, O Hebrew servant whom you have brought before us for our amusement.”
verses.18: And it came to pass that my voice became loud, and I cried out. He left his clothes behind me, and he rushed away.
verses.19: And when Adonai heard what his wife said to him, she said, “For these reasons did he make her your servant.” Then he became angry.
verses.20: And Adonai Yosef took him and gave him into the house of detention, a place where the king’s prisoners were kept. And there he remained in the house of detention.
verses.21: And Jehovah showed kindness to Joseph. He gave him a place to live in the eyes of the steward of the palace.
verses.22: And the governor of the prison house gave all the prisoners who were in the prison house to Joseph. He also gave him control over everything that was done there.
verses.23: There is no one in the house of God who can see all the wonders that Jehovah has done and who can witness them.
